label: Metis system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Metis locus that senses phage-mediated host-genome degradation through N6-methyl-deoxyadenosine monophosphate and activates a type-specific toxic effector.
observations: m6dAMP-sensing phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from free m6dAMP, host DNA methylases, host genome degradation without a complete Metis locus, type I and type II toxic effectors by themselves, NAD depletion or membrane-linked toxicity by themselves, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, and missing DefenseFinder rule rows.
